look_here_first: Start with the foliage texture and stature. Lindheimer's senna is a tall perennial with several velvety stems, 4–8 pairs of oblong leaflets, and conspicuously soft-hairy gray-green foliage. Yellow flowers cluster in upper leaf axils.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays project wild-observation pool + Travis county treatment + Val Verde Amistad inventory.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Introduced Purola planting excluded from range evidence.

best_field_traits: erect bushy habit, often over 1 m
yellow 5-petaled flowers in upper axillary clusters
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Perennial, many velvety leaflet pairs, tall bushy habit.

comparisons.key_distinctions: S. roemeriana has one leaflet pair; S. pilosior is annual and more western/desert-associated.

images.caption: Source-labeled Senna lindheimeriana foliage close-up showing the pubescent gray-green leaflets. Use the hairiness as a vegetative cue alongside flowers and pods.
